blocks.text: Biochemistry science ki woh shaakh hai jo jaandaron mein paye jane wale kimiyai maaddon aur un ke reactions ka mutala karti hai. Hayatiyati compounds pecheeda molecules hain, lekin in mein wahi functional groups hote hain jo saada organic compounds mein: alcohol, amine, aldehyde, ketone, carboxylic acid, ester aur amide groups.

Yeh chapter zaroori biomolecules, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids, un ki banawat, kaam aur cell mein kirdar samet, aur biochemical amal mein enzymes aur minerals ka kirdar bhi bayan karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Is chapter mein parhi jane wali biomolecules ki chaar qismein batayein.
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids.

items: Biomolecules mein aam functional groups: -OH, -NH2, C=O, -COOH, esters, amides.
